Author: Weslley08
Name: Clima Pro
Description: Live weather on your keys, in the theme you choose, with official Defesa Civil alerts in Brazil. Weather data by WeatherAPI.com, for general information only: never the sole basis for safety-critical decisions.
Detail: Clima Pro shows the latest conditions and details on your deck, with six themes to choose from. Press a key to switch screens. In Brazil it also marks official Defesa Civil alerts (IDAP feed) over the forecast; this does not replace official channels. Setup: create a free WeatherAPI.com key, paste it into the settings panel, and pick a place and a theme. Weather data by WeatherAPI.com. Weather information displayed here is provided for general informational purposes only. Forecasts and conditions are probabilistic and may not be accurate for your specific location or time. This data should not be used as the sole basis for decisions involving personal safety, aviation, marine navigation, emergency planning, or other safety-critical activities. Always consult official meteorological services and relevant authorities for decisions where accuracy is critical.
